This is a Next.js React dashboard for a universal AI-powered product-mapper. Prioritize code that:
- Connects to the backend /map endpoint for scraping and matching
- Lets users input affiliate URLs, selectors, userId, and match threshold
- Displays scraped products and matches in a modern, user-friendly UI
- Supports selector helper and job history features
- Uses TypeScript, Tailwind, and Material UI best practices
